pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular multi-polygonal regions with crenulated edges; medium spatial area with sharp pixel gradients defining the boundaries between dark and light regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected pathways of light pelage forming a topological graph with predominantly tri-radial and quadri-radial junction nodes; pixel thickness is relatively uniform across the visible flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Serrated 1D geometric contour with high-frequency, low-amplitude vertical hair-tip projections against the sky and background foliage.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Localized area of dark, hyper-pigmented textural disruption and surface irregularity visible on the mid-dorsal ridge area.

other_distinctive_markers: An avian organism (Buphagus) is perched on the posterior dorsal ridge area.
